d:
Mahishasura Mardini Stotram | Ayigiri Nandini Nanditha Medini
Ayigiri nandini nanditi medini, vishv vinodini nandinute
Girivar vindhyashirodhinivasini, vishnu vilasinijishnunute
Bhagavti he shitikanth kutumbini, bhuri kutumbini bhut krite
Jay jay he mahishasur mardini, ramy kapardini shailsute
Survarvarshini durdhardharshini durmukh marshini harsharte
Tribhuvan poshini shankartoshini kilbishmoshini ghosharte
Danujniroshini ditisutroshini durmadshoshini sindhusute
